name: LastAgentRouting_Template
description:
This Flow checks if someone called in the last 24 hours and routes the call to the same person. 
It is a Last Agent Routing example flow.
Uses HTTP into WebexCC APIs to the Search API, using GraphQL.

promptsTts.value: Hello, welcome to the last agent routing demo. We will lookup your info and route you to the last agent you spoke to.
promptsTts.name: Hello, welcome to the last agent routing demo. We will lookup your info and route you to the last agent you spoke to.

properties.destinationLookupType:name: ID
properties.description: Queue the call to preferred agent based on what is extracted from search API call.
properties.recoveryQueue:name: Q_arubhatt
properties.name: QueueToAgent_xh1
properties.reportingQueue:name: Q_arubhatt

properties.description: Queue to a default queue since no one was found previously.
properties.name: QueueToDefault
properties.destination:name: Q_arubhatt

properties.contentType_name:name: JSON
properties.description: Make /search API call to get the agentID who handled the previous call based on ANI
properties.httpRequestMethod_name:name: POST
properties.httpContentType_name:name: Application/JSON
properties.contentType:name: JSON
properties.connectorId:name: webexCC
properties.httpContentType:name: GraphQL
properties.httpContentType:name:name: Application/JSON
properties.httpRequestMethod:name:name: POST
properties.name: SearchAPILastAgent
properties.contentType:name:name: JSON
properties.httpRequestMethod:name: POST

properties.voiceLanguage:name: en-US-Standard-A
properties.description: Play the confirmation message that an Agent was found, and then route the caller to that agent.

properties.voiceLanguage:name:name: en-US-Standard-A
properties.name: PlayMessage_ee8
properties.voiceLanguage_name:name: en-US-Standard-A
